method: Real shared production scheduler, six active T1 DOM attachments at CSS400x240/DPR1/resolution1, three captures per explicit bound (1/8) in alternating order. 30 warmup submissions +120 measured completed submissions; no profiler, forced drawAt, per-frame await, or GPU readback inside capture. Completion callbacks report notified work completion and can be delivered in a batch. Both submitted and completed cadence are retained; callback latency is not GPU execution time. Six final readbacks validate rendered content after the timed region. JavaScript observed pending callbacks verify the bound; this is not physical GPU queue occupancy.
